intro_text: You can make a difference. Project Battambang continually appreciates the generosity, partnerships, and time of volunteers who help serve underprivileged communities in Cambodia.

opportunities.title: Calling All Doctors & Healthcare Professionals
opportunities.description: Project Battambang would like to reach out to all healthcare professionals who are keen on finding out more about the project in the interests of volunteering with us in improving healthcare for the people on Koh Dach Island, Cambodia.

opportunities.title: Make a Donation
opportunities.description: Project Battambang continually appreciates the generosity and involvement of people like you, with every contribution going towards patient medications, health screening supplies, and student scholarships.

opportunities.title: Partner with Us
opportunities.description: Want to join our efforts but not sure where to start? Partner with us through sponsorships of materials and resources to pave the path for better community health.
